items.title: Vercel Sandbox starts up to 4x faster
items.summary: now initializes up to 4x faster outside the Washington, D.C. () region when reused image data is served from a regional cache.Vercel Sandboxiad1Initialization now reads cached image data close to where the sandbox runs, avoiding round trips to origin image storage in  on cache hits. Regional caching supports managed and custom images backed by Vercel Container Registry, including snapshots based on those images.iad1In internal end-to-end benchmarks with , startup time fell about 75% in Paris and from about 3.5s to 1.05s in Seoul. Regions closer to origin storage generally see smaller improvements because requests already travel a shorter distance.Vercel Managed ImagesLearn more in the .Vercel Sandbox documentationRead more

items.title: Build cache size limit on Vercel increased to 5 GB
items.summary: The  size limit on all  has been increased to 5 GB. This allows projects to save more installed dependencies and framework files for reuse between deployments, which can reduce install and build times.build cacheVercel build machinesBuild machines are the compute environments that install dependencies and build your project before deployment. Previously, caches were discarded if they exceeded 1.5 GB on Basic and Standard, 3 GB on Enhanced, or 4.75 GB on Turbo, leaving the next build without a cache.The change applies automatically across all build machine types at no additional charge, with no configuration required.Learn more in the .build cache documentationRead more
